description: Search across the documentation to find relevant information, code examples, API references, and guides. Use this tool when you need to answer questions about BlockRazor, find specific documentation, understand how features work, or locate implementation details. The search returns contextual content with titles and direct links to the documentation pages.

language.description: The language the user is writing in. Pass it whenever you know it, so results come from the documentation in that language. Defaults to "en".

name: searchDocumentation
